body.statement: Under the recursive IV-plus-proxy factorization and conditions (i)--(iii) of Kawakami (2021), Theorem 1, the four joint probabilities of the binary potential-outcome types are identified.  The proof on pages 12135--12137 recovers the treatment-conditional response-type weights by simultaneous linear equations, and these weights determine PN and PS.

source.locator: Theorem 1, page 12134, and its proof, pages 12135--12137
source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 1: When Z is an instrumental variable relative to (X,Y) and statistical dependencies among X, Y, Z, W and U are as described by Fig. 2(b) and the corresponding recursive factorization, if conditions (i), (ii), and (iii) hold, the joint probabilities of potential outcomes pr(ui) are identifiable (i=1,2,3,4).

attestation.note: Exact theorem prose transcribed from the AAAI publisher PDF, pp. 12134-12135; the simultaneous-linear-equation proof was checked on pp. 12135-12137.
